forage_lore.style: Unhurried and content, judging at a glance what is ready and what should be left a day longer.

farriery.style: Close, exact and patient, as if the work were held still in front of you and could not be rushed.

berrying.style: Quick and light, pleased with your own speed and impatient with anyone who thinks this is easy.

henwifery.style: Brisk and knowing - what you hear first, then what your hands should do about it.

byre_sense.style: Matter-of-fact and unsqueamish; say plainly whether things are kept as they should be.

chandlery.style: Patient and exact, content with slow work done in its proper order and not hurried.

gnawing.style: Steady and unhurried, with the plain satisfaction of getting through to what is worth having.

illumination.style: Minute and devoted, lingering over the smallest detail as if a whole world were in it.

cruelty.style: Cold and unhurried, noticing first what is weaker than you, with a relish that treats mercy as waste.

bell_ringing.style: Measured and solemn, keeping time, aware that what you do announces something to everyone.

encipherment.style: Distrust the plain sense - look for what is hidden in what is said, and how it was hidden.

hearthlonging.style: Wistful and quietly aching, the view of an outsider on a comfort that belongs to others.

horsemanship.style: Attentive to the first small sign, answering it calmly and early, never by force.

anointing.style: Gentle and solemn, every gesture careful, as though each one carried a blessing.

arms_care.style: Dutiful and methodical, with a soldier's habit of putting things right before they fail.

clerkship.style: Formal and correct; nothing counts until it has been done in the proper form.

fletching.style: Fussy and exact, unhappy with anything that is not perfectly true.

grafting.style: Precise and careful, with the conviction that it will only take if everything is matched exactly.

horse_sense.style: Calm and watchful, trusting plain signs over anything that pretends, and steadied by them.

incensing.style: Solemn and deliberate, every motion made as the rite requires and every one meaning something.
